notes.title: Toribash Next 1.3
notes.content:
Hi, Toribash Next 1.3 update is now available!
This update features Steam Workshop integration for mod sharing, various performance improvements, more bug fixes and other tweaks


Mod sharing via Workshop
You can now share any created mod on Steam Workshop for other players to try!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/12287b08b99b61d5d6f615dda71b2bb057821b98.png
Right-click on your mod listing in Mods menu and choose "Upload to Workshop" option from the tooltip menu to access the upload screen.
In addition to mod name, you can specify an optional description and upload a preview of your mod to make it easier for others to recognize it - both in Workshop browser and in Mods menu.

Other updates in TBN v1.3
Tweaks to Classic, Aikido and Samurai Fight game modes
Joint tooltip now also shows joint name in addition to its state
Added 'V' hotkey to quickly toggle all grips on or off
Any events caused by player collisions (score gain, fractures, dismembers, etc) during stancing are now ignored
Improvements to mod saver to drastically decrease output file size by preventing duplicate data
Netcode improvements for faster mod syncing for newly joined players
Being left alone in a multiplayer room now instantly makes you its operator
Fixed bug with tab menu potentially getting stuck when opening main menu while it hasn't finished animating
Various fixes to prevent incorrect replay / mod data parsing during p2p transfers
Fixed bug with 3D items, effect items and head texture not showing correctly

notes.title: Toribash Next 1.2 - 27/01/24 Update
notes.content:
This update features more bug fixes and minor improvements to Toribash Next:
Fixed crash after inventory load that was affecting some users
Fixed potential data parsing failure crashes while in Multiplayer
Fixed bug that was causing connection errors when attempting to join a new room after leaving multiplayer
Fixed UI bug that was leading to buttons in Play screen to retain pressed state
Fixed bug that was leading to incorrect currency display in ToriCoins purchase screen for some regions that use USD
Match intro tweaks to ensure correct info display after joining new room
Disabled "Disconnected" Play screen state due to redundancy as game client now instantly enters offline mode with last game state upon leaving online room
Updated X hotkey to enable Hold state by default instead of Relax

If you experience an issue that has not been addressed by this most recent update, please email a description to tbnsupport@nabistudios.com and we’ll check it out.

Thanks for any feedback! We greatly appreciate your support as we continue to refine and improve Toribash Next. Please check back here for more updates coming in the near future.

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.93 - 23/09/22 Update
notes.content:
Changes in today's update:
Fixed bug with auto turn skipping in offline mode
Fixed bug with spawn position resetting to 0 when starting new game from Gamerules menu
Room list refresh fixes and mod display
Apply and New Game buttons in Gamerules menu will now be greyed out for players who can't use them
Auto hide chat input on match intro screen if it's your fight, keep it active and focused otherwise

notes.title: Toribash 0.93
notes.content:
New in Toribash Next 0.93:
Fixed op / mute / kick functionality in player tooltip menu
Gamerules can now be modified by all room operators
Fixed bug with some player tooltip buttons being overlayed by player list
Fixed bug with player list getting broken when there are users both in queue and spectators list
Fixed gun bullets not being displayed when in Offline Mode
Fixed bug that was preventing from skipping to next/previous frame when replay is paused
Fixed bug with head texture being rendered at low resolution when adding new decal in head customizer

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.92
notes.content:
Updates in Toribash Next 0.92:
New item materials: Metal, Plastic and Polished
Force, Relax and Base color items will randomly get one of the available materials
Post-fight TC rewards
Ghost visibility toggling with G / B keys
TC display in main game hud
Reflections options in Graphics
Lots of other minor tweaks and fixes

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.91 - 09/09/22 Update
notes.content:
Changes in today's build:
Added customizable mouse click and wheel scroll modes for character controls
New chat visuals with markdown support for bold, italics, underscore and strikethrough text

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.91 - 08/09/22 Update
notes.content:
Updates in this build:
Backend changes to render scale - UI is now always drawn at native resolution
Added default head texture to use when player hasn't customized their own head yet
Press R while ghosting to play current fight up to current frame without triggering a full replay
Replaced chat status messages on saving mods/replays with UI popups
Fixed bug with notifications' dismiss button being unresponsive
Fixed bug with "Disconnected: None" error when opening room list
Fixed bug with game freeze on first launch
Fixes to ghost being a bit too opaque after last update

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.91
notes.content:
Updates in Toribash Next 0.91:
Offline mode
Settings menu with Graphics and Audio settings
New player body visual materials
Improved shadows
Fixed bug that was causing performance drops in some UI

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.90 - 31/08/22 Update
notes.content:
Updates in this build:
Settings menu with Graphics and Audio
Some graphics settings do not currently work
Menu buttons now become interactive earlier and don't wait for the whole menu / tab to finish loading
Added smooth transition to default head rotation in head customizer
Fixed bug with deactivated inventory items getting stuck on player preview
Fixed bug with cead customizer decal buttons becoming unresponsive

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.90 - 29/08/22 Update
notes.content:
Updates in this build:
Added music composed by Matarika
Added buttons to load mod / replay from disk to browser menus
Updated joint state feedback to stand out better on darker joints
Updated bruising - self collisions and collisions that didn't generate score will no longer bruise bodyparts, player-environment collisions will only cause bruising if they have high enough magnitude
Fixed bug with notifications becoming undismissable
Fixed bug with native file browser not opening on macOS
Changed versioning scheme to major.minor.build

notes.title: Toribash Next 0.82 - 25/05/22
notes.content:
Hi, Toribash Next 0.82 is now available!
Please note that this release bumps up net version to 0.82 - players on earlier builds will not be able to see / join your rooms (and vice versa).

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/36605742/83ee0bfad36e045c37d868125669aa1d21c85975.png

Big stuff
Customizable head textures and editor (can be accessed from Inventory)
Performance improvements (expect significantly better performance, especially on lower end hardware)
Breaking changes to stancing: stance frames value needs to be 10x lower than before

Other changes
Fixed colors order for player 3 and 4
Display name prefix (@) for active fighters if one is applicable
Increased raycast distance to make sure you can select players from afar
Increased freecam movement speed
Chat size toggle with backquote (`)
Prevent mouse cursor from going outside the window
Custom cursor image that reacts to hovering over buttons / players
Translucent camera avatars for spectators
Fixed environment ghost materials
Updated ghosts to be always drawn behind regular objects
Tweaked chat input window size to prevent it from overlaying player info text
Game modes screen design is now in line with other screens
Fixed bug with extra joint spawning in main menu's player preview


Join Toribash Next discussion channel: https://discord.gg/KSM3hT7
